scenario: Integer arithmetic stability per LDET.9.8 — basic integer operations (+, -, *) produce bit-identical results across runs. Pin: rule that adds two int slots emits a result fact; log action fires confirming the value is exact.
rules_ds:
schema Pair scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable

rule r:
    Pair p where p.a + p.b == 42
->
    log info "exact"
